recommendation: Freeze the current compiler as the comparison baseline now and make a small, checked rewrite pilot the next implementation phase. Continue fixing basic source-alignment/quotation bugs separately; stop open-ended grammar expansion.
reason: The remaining 451 strict refusals are 19.0% of 2,375, not a handful of proven outliers. The audit also finds passing outputs with missing bindings. A fixed-baseline rewrite comparison is more useful for the intended method paper than another unbounded series of rules. No measured diminishing-return curve or rewrite success is claimed.

pilot.model: One frozen text model; minimal text edits, unchanged output or explicit refusal when meaning cannot be preserved. No fine-tuning. The rewriter receives the claim and existing text parses, not truth labels or media observations.
focus: Phrasal verbs and implicit sentence boundaries
Long coordination and nonfinite clause attachment
Explicit lists, numeric/time formatting and nominal fragments with a clear reading
checks: Simplify wording without correcting the claim facts, including deliberately false claims
Preserve who did what to whom, shared participants and quantifier scope
Preserve names, quantities with their owners, dates, tense/aspect, polarity and modality
Preserve exact quotations and speech/OCR/depiction boundaries
Check compiled predicates against the ORIGINAL claim as well as the rewritten text
Reject added assertions, guessed references or unsupported comparison/negation semantics
proposed_goals: At least 12 of 24 failed development targets yield reviewed faithful compiled outputs
Zero accepted critical changes to participants, quantities, polarity, time, modality, quotations or source scope
Unsupported/ambiguous guard cases may remain refused; an increased syntax-pass count alone is not success
pilot.evaluation_limit: These are proposed development gates, not measured results or a statistical accuracy guarantee. Reserve source groups before prompt tuning; the current audit is development context.
pilot.target_selection: Choose24 targets with a reviewed missing value/relation or a parser refusal with a clear reading. Keep likely overstrict-only alerts out of the semantic-recovery count; put ambiguous or unsupported cases in the guard set.

do_not_force: Quantified absence such as no audio/no narration when joint existence/negation is not supported
Would/counterfactual readings not covered by the current operators
Ambiguous relative-clause antecedents or unsupported the-more/the-more comparisons
Quotes: retain exact wording; fix compiler protection rather than paraphrasing them
before_training: Freeze compiler and rewrite prompts after the pilot, review original/rewrite/predicate triples, retain refusals and train only on checked structures. Broader accepted counts are not clean training labels.
